name: net-proxy-tool
description: The checks and commands that net-proxy-tool needs while an agent works on it.

commands.name: session brief
commands.description: The branch, the uncommitted work, the version agreement and the standing rules.

commands.name: standard library check
commands.description: Reports any runtime import outside the standard library.

commands.name: secret scan
commands.description: Reports a credential or a private identifier in the staged change.

commands.name: release consistency
commands.description: Reports every version placeholder that does not agree.

commands.name: related tests
commands.description: Runs the test modules that belong to the files that changed.

commands.name: demo
commands.description: Runs the whole flow through the local observation gateway.

rules: The power never writes the configuration and never switches a node.
A push, a release, a deployment and a change of a remote node need the maintainer's approval.
The commands that could print a remote URL, a token or the console configuration are blocked by the hooks.
